spans.s:
अप्न m. (-प्नः) (ved.) A son, progeny; (according to Mahī-
dhara's view of the form अप्नः

., which therefore
is according to him the nom. of अप्न--comp. अप्नस्--,
in his explanation of अप्नवानः--see अप्नवन् and अप्नवान
--
.). E. अप् (comp. the E. of अप्त), uṇ. aff. न (?).

अप्नःस्थ Tatpur. m. (-स्थः) (ved.) One who superintends work,
an overseer. E. अप्नस् and स्थ.

अप्नराज् Tatpur. m. (-ट्) (ved.) Splendent through (their)
work; an epithet of the Aśvins. E. अप्न (instead of अप्नस्)
and राज्.

अप्नवन् m. pl. (-वानः) (ved.) Having sons, having progeny;
(according to Mahīdhara's comm. on अप्नवानो भृगवः

., also as a proper name; but Sāyaṇa takes in the corre-
sponding passage of the Ṛgv.

. अप्नवानः for the nom.
sing. of अप्नवान, an interpretation probably more correct
than that of Mahīdhara). E. अप्न, taddh. aff. वनिप् (?).

अप्नवान m. (-नः) (ved.)
 ^1 The arm.
 ^2 The name of a Ṛṣi
of the family of Bhṛgu; (comp. अप्नवन्). E. (probably)
अप् (comp. the E. of अप्त), kṛt aff. शानन्, and meaning
liter. ‘taking possession of, seizing’.

अप्नवानवत् ind. (ved.) Like the Ṛṣi Apnavāna. E. अप्नवान,
taddh. aff. वति.

अप्नस् n. (-प्नः) (ved.)
 ^1 Work; also, religious work, a sacri-
ficial act.
 ^2 Wealth.
 ^3 Shape. (The meaning ‘progeny’ be-
longs to the base अप्न q. v., according to Madhīdhara.) E.
आप् with आ shortened (according to the native E., but
more correctly अप्, comp. the E. of अप्त), uṇ. aff. असुन्,
āgama नुट्.

अप्नस्वत् m. f. n. (-स्वान्-स्वती-स्वत्) (ved.) Connected with
work (e. g. a sacrificial ground where digging and other
work is done, or speech joined to sacrificial acts). E.
अप्नस्, taddh. aff. मतुप्.
